recognize_zh: CD10 染色僅在結節周圍的真皮基質（纖維母細胞／血管周圍）呈條紋狀陽性，結節內的 B 細胞則為陰性；腫瘤細胞 CD10 陰性有助排除皮膚濾泡中心淋巴瘤，支持邊緣區淋巴瘤。
features: Large dermal lymphoid nodule composed of CD10-negative cells
Streaky, reticular CD10 staining of stromal cells and fibroblasts around and between nodules
No CD10-positive germinal center-type cells within the nodule
Epidermis/adnexal epithelium at upper right negative
describe_en: CD10 immunostain of the skin biopsy shows a large dermal lymphoid nodule that is negative for CD10. Staining is restricted to streaky stromal and perivascular cells surrounding and dissecting the nodules. No CD10-positive follicle center cells are identified within the infiltrate. The lack of CD10 expression by the lesional B cells argues against a follicle center cell origin and is consistent with primary cutaneous marginal zone lymphoma.

ddx.vs: PCFCL neoplastic cells are BCL6 positive and frequently CD10 positive in follicular areas, whereas the lesional nodule here is CD10 negative.

ddx.dx: Cutaneous lymphoid hyperplasia with germinal centers
ddx.vs: Reactive germinal centers contain CD10-positive centroblasts and centrocytes in discrete follicles, which are not seen in this nodule.
MCL is also CD10 negative, so cyclin D1 and SOX11 are needed to exclude it.
